scenes.title: DAY 1 — THE CLASSROOM
scenes.speaker: Sir Tris
scenes.text: Andreng, in your Entrepreneurship class, remember this: a business is not just income, it is responsibility. Budget wisely, serve honestly, and plan before you spend.

choices.text: Create a realistic plan for the family.
Say you will do anything to get money fast.

scenes.title: DAY 2 — THE PROBLEM AT HOME
scenes.speaker: Andreng
scenes.text: Mang Cruz looks exhausted. 'We're drowning in debt, anak. We need help.' Andreng feels the pressure growing heavier with every unpaid bill.

choices.text: Create a family plan and look for honest work.
Look for a quick way to make money without thinking it through.
Ignore the problem for now and delay the decision.

scenes.title: DAY 2 — A TEMPORARY PANIC
scenes.speaker: Narrator
scenes.text: Andreng feels the urge to escape the problem, but the debt remains. The pressure pushes him toward a risky idea.

choices.text: Move toward the risky money plan.

scenes.title: DAY 3 — ANYAPOT'S OFFER
scenes.speaker: Anyapot
scenes.text: Anyapot says, 'I can lend you fifteen thousand for a fresh start, but kailangan mo talagang magplano. Hindi pwedeng gamitan ng sugal ang pera.'

choices.text: Save the money and build a business plan first.
Divide it between savings and business research.

scenes.title: DAY 3 — ANYAPOT'S OFFER
scenes.speaker: Anyapot
scenes.text: Anyapot offers a loan and warns him to use it responsibly. Andreng decides to gamble on a risky shortcut.

choices.text: Spend the money on a gamble.

scenes.title: DAY 3 — ANYAPOT'S CALL
scenes.speaker: Anyapot
scenes.text: Anyapot tells Andreng that although she wants to help, excuses do not solve family problems. He needs a plan, not paralysis.

choices.text: Accept a fresh start with a real business plan.

scenes.title: DAY 4 — THE RAINY STREET
scenes.speaker: Anyapot
scenes.text: Rain falls hard. Anyapot finds Andreng soaked and ashamed. He admits he lost the money. She is disappointed but still offers a second chance.

choices.text: Accept responsibility and make a budget with her help.
Make empty promises without a real plan.

scenes.title: DAY 4 — BUSINESS ADVICE
scenes.speaker: Anyapot
scenes.text: Anyapot gives practical advice: start small, manage inventory, set fair prices, and treat customers with respect.

choices.text: Use the budget to start FoodLoop.

scenes.title: DAY 5 — BUILDING FOODLOOP
scenes.speaker: Narrator
scenes.text: FoodLoop begins as a small home-based karinderya. Andreng prepares a budget, buys ingredients, and sets a menu with affordable meals.

choices.text: Finalize the budget and open the business.

scenes.title: DAY 6 — THE FIRST CUSTOMERS
scenes.speaker: Customer
scenes.text: The first customers arrive hungry and hopeful. Success depends on accuracy, speed, and honest pricing.

choices.text: Serve orders carefully and build trust.
Rush the service and risk complaints.

scenes.title: DAY 7 — GROWING THE BUSINESS
scenes.speaker: Sir Tris
scenes.text: Good businesses grow from profit and discipline. Reinvest wisely, save for emergencies, and treat coworkers and customers with respect.

choices.text: Reinvest in better equipment and expand carefully.

scenes.title: DAY 8 — THE BULLYING INCIDENT
scenes.speaker: Narrator
scenes.text: Carlong, Franko, and Hirkuliys throw eggs and damage FoodLoop. Andreng is shaken but must choose how to respond.

choices.text: Stay calm, document the damage, and seek help.
Fight back and escalate the conflict.
Give up and abandon the business.

scenes.title: DAY 9 — ANGELINE'S REVEAL
scenes.speaker: Angeline
scenes.text: Angeline sees a photograph of Andreng's damaged home and realizes he is her son. She reveals the truth to Anyapot and helps rebuild the family.

choices.text: Move forward with honesty and family support.

scenes.title: DAY 10 — RESTORING FOODLOOP
scenes.speaker: Narrator
scenes.text: The family works to restore the business. Mang Cruz speaks of his mistakes and begins taking practical steps to recover.

choices.text: Repair FoodLoop carefully and reopen with a stronger plan.

scenes.title: DAY 11 — A NEW BEGINNING
scenes.speaker: Andreng
scenes.text: With lessons learned, Andreng reopens FoodLoop and commits to responsibility, fairness, and compassion.

choices.text: Continue toward a better future.

scenes.title: YEARS LATER — THE CITY
scenes.speaker: Narrator
scenes.text: Andreng is now a successful chef. He sees Carlong, Franko, and Hirkuliys on the sidewalk. The final question is not about revenge but about character.

choices.text: Offer respectful help and encourage them to rebuild their lives.
Humiliate them because of what they did.
Ignore them and keep walking.

scenes.title: GOOD ENDING — A LIFE REBUILT
scenes.speaker: Narrator
scenes.text: Andreng chooses kindness over revenge. He rebuilds the life he once almost lost, supporting his family, healing his friendships, and honoring the lessons of responsibility and mercy. 'Be a buddy, not a bully.'

scenes.title: BAD ENDING — THE COST OF BAD CHOICES
scenes.speaker: Narrator
scenes.text: The cycle continues. Andreng is forced to confront the pain his anger and poor decisions caused. The lesson is heavy: mistakes can be costly, but they can still be repaired with honesty and effort.

scenes.title: NEUTRAL ENDING — STILL LEARNING
scenes.speaker: Narrator
scenes.text: FoodLoop survives, but the road is still long. Andreng keeps learning how to balance ambition with responsibility, and small acts of improvement become the foundation for a better future.
